progressionRule: A dependent pass may proceed only when all required blocker rules are PASS.

rules.name: WALL_FRAGMENTATION
rules.intent: Prevent construction of one continuous wall system as many short fragments without a real BIM reason.
rules.passCondition: No unexplained excessive short-wall fragmentation is detected.

rules.name: WINDOW_NATIVE_TYPE
rules.intent: Windows must be real Window elements hosted by walls.
rules.passCondition: All intended windows are Window elements and Morph windows == 0.

rules.name: DOOR_NATIVE_TYPE
rules.intent: Doors must be real Door elements hosted by walls.
rules.passCondition: All intended doors are Door elements and Morph doors == 0.

rules.name: ROOF_COLLISIONS
rules.intent: Prevent unresolved volumetric penetrations between intended roof planes.
rules.passCondition: Unintended roof penetrations / overlapping unresolved roof solids == 0.

rules.name: ROOF_GAPS
rules.intent: The intended roof envelope must not contain unintended open gaps.
evidence: visual audit where transport is insufficient

rules.name: WALL_TOPS
rules.intent: Gable and roof-adjacent walls must derive their top geometry from a proper roof relationship, not stepped fragments.
rules.passCondition: No exterior wall protrudes unintentionally through the accepted roof and no stepped-fragment gable construction exists.

rules.name: RAFTER_ALIGNMENT
rules.intent: Rafters must derive from and agree with accepted roof geometry.
rules.passCondition: Each generated rafter aligns with the intended roof plane and correct bearing / ridge / valley geometry.

rules.name: STORY_ASSIGNMENT
rules.intent: Generated elements must belong to the intended story/elevation system.
rules.passCondition: All controlled elements have the intended story / floor assignment and declared elevation relationship.
evidence: base elevation when required by intent

rules.name: DUPLICATES
rules.intent: Retries and reconciliation must not create duplicate generated BIM elements.

rules.name: PASS_DEPENDENCY
rules.intent: Prevent false PASS and progression through an unresolved dependency.
rules.passCondition: Every blocker required by the pass is PASS; FAIL, NOT_VERIFIED and BLOCKED_BY_TRANSPORT block dependent progression.

rules.name: MINIMUM_ELEMENT_COUNT
rules.intent: Prefer the smallest semantically correct set of native BIM elements and Archicad operations over equivalent fragmentation.
rules.passCondition: Every controlled semantic role uses no more than its trusted maxElementCount unless a reviewed construction exception is present; operations are preferred over fragmentation where available.

rules.name: ROOF_TO_WALL_COVERAGE
rules.intent: Every exterior wall line that is intended to be roof-covered must be reached by the roof and satisfy its verified design overhang/reach requirement.
rules.passCondition: Actual roof reach/overhang is not less than the verified rule value for every scoped wall/roof relation.

rules.name: WALL_CONNECTIVITY
rules.intent: Walls intended to meet must form actual T/L/X/end/collinear junctions without unexplained gaps.
rules.passCondition: Every intended wall junction is connected and its measured gap is within the verified rule value.

rules.name: VERTICAL_LOADBEARING_CONTINUITY
rules.intent: Upper-storey load-bearing walls must have an explicit continuous support path to intended structural elements below.
rules.passCondition: Every scoped load-bearing wall satisfies verified support-ratio and horizontal-offset rules or an explicitly reviewed transfer-structure intent.

rules.name: WALL_OPENING_CONFLICT
rules.intent: No wall or partition may enter, split or terminate inside an intended Window/Door opening zone.
rules.passCondition: No checked wall intersects an opening and every wall/opening pair satisfies its verified minimum clearance.

rules.name: OPENING_EDGE_CLEARANCE
rules.intent: Window/Door positions, corner offsets, wall offsets and pier widths must be dimensioned against verified rule values rather than visually distributed.
rules.passCondition: Every required opening-to-corner, opening-to-wall, between-opening, pier and jamb measurement meets its verified minimum.

rules.name: MASONRY_MODULE_FIT
rules.intent: Masonry wall runs, piers, jambs and opening offsets must follow the explicitly selected verified masonry coordination module.
rules.passCondition: Every scoped masonry dimension fits the verified moduleStep/allowedResidues within the verified moduleTolerance.
